news.title: GitLab jumps on Q2 beat, raised guidance
news.summary: GitLab (GTLB) reported Q2 non-GAAP EPS of 24c vs. 18c expected on revenue of $286.25M vs. $273.12M expected, and raised full-year adjusted EPS and revenue guidance. Shares were up roughly 20-25% pre-market with several sell-side price-target increases following the print.

news.title: Dell rallies on FQ2 beat, raised full-year outlook
news.summary: Dell (DELL) beat on both adjusted EPS and revenue for its fiscal Q2 and raised full-year guidance. Shares were up about 8-9% pre-market, with elevated options volume on the name.

news.title: MongoDB slides despite beating estimates
news.summary: MongoDB (MDB) beat Q2 estimates on both earnings and revenue, but shares fell 11-14% pre-market after a couple of sell-side price-target cuts -- a guidance-driven pullback rather than a miss on the quarter itself.

news.title: Credo Technology drops on latest quarterly report
news.summary: Credo Technology (CRDO) fell 8-10% pre-market following its most recent earnings report, joining today's list of earnings-driven movers.

news.title: U.S. strikes on Iran, retaliatory attacks reported near Gulf bases
news.summary: U.S. Central Command said it struck Iranian military targets overnight after Iran's Revolutionary Guard attempted attacks on Gulf shipping; Iran was reported to have launched retaliatory strikes toward U.S. bases in the region. Oil and Treasury yields both ticked up in the aftermath (10-year yield near its highest since late 2023), adding a layer of macro risk to the session.

news.title: ADP employment, factory orders, and the Fed Beige Book due today
news.summary: Wednesday's economic calendar includes the ADP August private-payrolls report, July factory orders, and the Federal Reserve's Beige Book. None are policy decisions on their own, but they're today's scheduled data points ahead of Friday's nonfarm payrolls.

news.title: Bitcoin and Ether soften into the open, proxy basket tracking spot
news.summary: BTC and ETH both traded lower into Wednesday's session, with SOL down further; the crypto-proxy equity basket (MSTR, COIN, CRCL, and others) has been moving roughly in line with spot rather than diverging, unlike Tuesday evening's gap.
